svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step three violet resist lines stand on three flat blanket films over a flat pale oxide with two small tungsten plugs in it. After it the resist is gone and the films remain only as three separate lines, one over each plug and one in the middle, with bare oxide between them.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step three violet resist lines stand on three flat blanket films over a flat pale oxide with two small tungsten plugs in it. After it the resist is gone and the films remain only as three separate lines, one over each plug and one in the middle, with bare oxide between them.
svg.text: A chlorine plasma etches the stack between
the resist lines; the resist is stripped.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
